summary: Dig Dug entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Dig Dug
entries.definitive_edition: Arcade Archives DIG DUG, with original arcade hardware noted as the ceiling

emulation.emulator: Arcade Archives wrapper; MAME only for hardware comparison
emulation.notes: Use Arcade Archives for the main route; compare MAME/original hardware only if timing accuracy is being audited.

primary.why: Arcade Archives is the easiest current legal route that targets faithful reproduction of the original 1982 Namco arcade game. Original arcade hardware remains the fidelity ceiling, but the Hamster release is the practical archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Arcade Archives DIG DUG. Record platform, display/filter settings, difficulty/DIP options, input mapping, save-state/rewind use, score mode, and whether original hardware or the 2016 PC Arcade Game Series release was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original hardware timing, controls, CRT display, and cabinet behavior
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if validating timing/input against hardware.
secondary.why: Arcade Archives is convenient, but original hardware is the fidelity ceiling.

secondary.platform: Arcade Game Series: Dig Dug on Windows PC
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the 2016 PC release.
secondary.why: The Arcade Game Series entry is tracked separately, including frame-rate caveats.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record display filters, settings, score modes, and whether modern conveniences such as rewind/save states were disabled.
